title: DeepOpen: Decision-Oriented Intent Classification on BANKING77 and CLINC150
abstract: arXiv:2610.31104v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present DeepOpen, a decision-Oriented intent-classification framework with dataset- specific systems for BANKING77 and CLINC150. On BANKING77, a single English classi- fier continued with sharpness-aware minimization (SAM) achieves 94.1234% test accuracy (2,899/3,080). This is the best observed result among three fixed SAM seeds, selected for display after test evaluation; their mean is 94.0368%. On the 150 in-scope CLINC150 classes, probability fusion of one Laya specialist and three DeBERTa-v3-large classifiers achieves 98.0222% (4,411/4,500). We describe the two configurations, reproduce the reference com- parisons displayed in the accompanying evaluation explorer, and separate headline scores from evidence about improvement. translated_title: DeepOpen：面向决策的BANKING77与CLINC150意图分类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了DeepOpen，一个面向决策的意图分类框架，针对BANKING77和CLINC150数据集分别设计了专用系统。在BANKING77上，单一英文分类器经过锐度感知最小化（SAM）续训后达到94.1234%的测试准确率（2,899/3,080），这是三个固定SAM随机种子中观察到的最佳结果，在测试评估后选出用于展示；其平均值为94.0368%。在CLINC150的150个域内类别上，一个Laya专家模型与三个DeBERTa-v3-large分类器的概率融合达到98.0222%（4,411/4,500）。我们描述了这两种配置，复现了随附评估浏览器中展示的参考对比，并将头条分数与改进证据区分开来。在统一的BANKING77评估路径下，SAM平均值比历史检查点高出0.0433个百分点，共享行的95%区间为[-0.2273, +0.3247]。因此，续训并未……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DeepOpen提出了针对BANKING77和CLINC150的面向决策意图分类框架，通过SAM续训的单分类器和多模型概率融合方法，分别在两个数据集上取得了94.12%和98.02%的高准确率，同时严谨地区分了头条分数与统计意义上的改进证据。
en_tdlr: DeepOpen is a decision-oriented intent classification framework achieving 94.12% accuracy on BANKING77 via SAM fine-tuning and 98.02% on CLINC150 through probability fusion of a Laya specialist and DeBERTa-v3-large classifiers, while carefully separating headline scores from statistically grounded evidence of improvement.
